controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Selected DISC light-curve model: full axes 115 × 111 × 19 m, assuming geometric albedo 0.1. The same study permits a 324 × 42 × 42 m CIGAR solution. These are competing inferred shapes; no resolved silhouette or surface map exists. Size depends on the assumed albedo. Arbitrary display pole and meridian. The object tumbles; this static view does not reconstruct its 2017 attitude or claim a current spin phase. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Published light-curve interpretation
